title: Training Note — Late Answers to Notices of Claim and the Cooperation Share in Penalty Relief
content:
**The rule.** On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the full penalty paid in a penalty relief request is multiplied by a cooperation share. The cooperation share follows the most recent answer the employer gave to a notice of claim on its benefit charge positions under Employer Benefit Charging that is recorded as late without good cause; answers recorded as late with good cause do not count.

| That most recent late answer was received | Cooperation share |
|---|---|
| No more than 365 days before the request | 0.85 |
| More than 365 days but no more than 730 days before the request | 0.95 |
| No such answer within 730 days | 1 |

**Records read.** The employer's charge positions under Employer Benefit Charging: for each answer to a notice of claim, its timeliness as recorded and the date it was received. Days are counted in calendar days from the date the answer was received to the day of the request.

## Questions and answers (hypothetical)

**The latest answer recorded as late without good cause was received 365 days before the request?** That is no more than 365 days: 0.85.

**Received 366 days before?** More than 365 but no more than 730: 0.95.

**Received 730 days before?** 0.95. **Received 731 days before?** No such answer within 730 days: 1.

**The only late answer on record is recorded as late with good cause, received 40 days before?** It does not count; with no other late answer, the share is 1.

**Answers recorded as on time?** They play no part.
